clips.title: The story
paras: Anvilmar is a fortified dwarven outpost nestled in the snowy depths of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Centered around a massive stone forge, it serves as the primary training grounds and rallying point for young Bronzebeard dwarves and displaced gnomish refugees beginning their adventures.

Tucked away in the northern crags of Coldridge Valley, Anvilmar stands as an enduring symbol of dwarven perseverance. Dominated by a roaring central forge, this sturdy masonry complex houses class mentors, supply vendors, and veteran mountain mountaineers who drill recruits before sending them out into the wider kingdom. Though sheltered behind towering drifts, the settlement remains on constant guard against the hostile Frostmane trolls and aggressive wild beasts prowling the frozen valley.
